checklists.name: Human bottleneck check
questions: Is direction judgment clear enough for Agents to execute?
Are tasks decomposed with acceptance criteria?
Can context move between Agents without constant human translation?
Can the human verify and integrate outputs fast enough?
Is emotional load or cash flow pressure distorting decisions?
checklists.decision_rule: If the human cannot judge, verify, or integrate outputs, fix the management system before adding more Agents.

checklists.name: Agent management layer check
questions: Are there more than two execution Agents or more than two functional domains?
Who owns task queue, context sync, risk summary, and blocked task escalation?
How does the human see progress without being interrupted by every subtask?
What is the review cadence and output format?
checklists.decision_rule: When coordination cost rises, add a management layer or process before expanding execution capacity.

checklists.name: Value loop check
questions: Who has the pain?
How do they solve it now?
What evidence shows the pain is strong enough?
Will they pay, switch, or repeatedly use the product?
Can delivery cost stay below the value captured?
checklists.decision_rule: If the value loop is unproven, run a demand or delivery probe before building a larger Agent architecture.

checklists.name: Service boundary check
questions: Does each customer need hand holding, installation, or environment debugging?
Do third party model, tool, or platform updates create support debt?
Is customization becoming the main product?
Does paid usage create ongoing result responsibility that the human must absorb?
Will short term revenue consume the time needed for the main product?
checklists.decision_rule: If support and customization dominate, name the offer as service, hybrid, or productized service, then price and bound it deliberately.

checklists.name: External organization check
questions: Who can provide real user feedback?
Who can test the product in a real workflow?
Who can supply distribution, customers, domain context, legal, finance, or operations support?
Which missing resource cannot be replaced by Agents yet?
checklists.decision_rule: A one person team still needs outside reality contact. Build a lightweight external resource map.

checklists.name: Hype calibration check
questions: Which claims are verified facts?
Which claims are trend narratives or founder stories?
Would the same decision still make sense without the extreme case?
What small test can produce local evidence for this user?
checklists.decision_rule: Use extreme cases as inspiration only. Make decisions from local evidence and reversible probes.
